documentId.description: Saved document UUID whose revision was checked before returning the rewrite.

original.description: Complete decoded saved text submitted for rewriting.

enhanced.description: Complete proposed rewrite returned by the provider; not applied to the document.

changed.description: Whether the proposed rewrite differs from the original text.

changes.description: Unavailable: this operation does not produce a verified edit list.

suggestions.description: Unavailable: the provider returns a rewrite without separate suggestions.

qualityValidation.description: Unavailable: no independent quality validation of the rewrite is performed.

metrics.description: Native measurements of original and revised prose; failed measurements remain null.

originalWordCount.description: Native word count of the original text, or null when unavailable.

enhancedWordCount.description: Native word count of the proposed rewrite, or null when unavailable.

readabilityChange.description: Native Flesch reading-ease difference, revised minus original; unavailable when either measurement fails.

changesApplied.description: Unavailable: edits are not enumerated or applied by this operation.

availability.description: Explicitly identifies unmeasured metadata and failed native measurements.

status.description: A rewrite is available, but edit lists and independent quality validation are not.

unavailableFields.description: Result field paths returned as null because no measurement or assessment is available.

coverage.description: Complete decoded source range and text digest used for this rewrite.

start.description: Inclusive UTF-16 start offset of the source text.

end.description: Exclusive UTF-16 end offset of the complete source text.

sourceCharacters.description: UTF-16 length of the complete decoded saved document text.

sourceRevision.description: SHA-256 of complete decoded text; envelope revisions identify saved RTF.

truncated.description: Always false because enhancement requires the complete source to fit its limit.

envelope.description: Provenance linking the request to its source revisions, engine settings and execution policy.

requestId.description: Deterministic SHA-256 of canonical project, scope, revision, control, policy, request and engine-version inputs; excludes createdAt.

projectId.description: Project identity or isolated queue-instance identity; null when the request has neither.

createdAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this provenance envelope was created.

sourceFormat.description: Source representation hashed for revisions: saved RTF text or caller-supplied text, encoded as UTF-8.

scope.description: Request scope and ordered identifiers of the source documents used.

kind.description: Scope category: manuscript, document-level request or author-evidence annotation analysis.

items.description: Source document identifier used in sourceRevisions.

documentIds.description: Source document identifiers in analysis order; saved documents use binder UUIDs.

sourceRevisions.description: Revision fingerprint for each source document, in the same order as scope.documentIds.

items.description: Document identity paired with the exact input revision used for analysis.

documentId.description: Source identifier matching the corresponding scope.documentIds entry.

revision.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 source representation identified by sourceFormat, before analysis.

engine.description: Selected analysis backend and fingerprints of its recorded configuration and author controls.

name.description: Analysis backend family selected by the execution policy.

version.description: Installed Narrative Lens package version; null for provider or scrivener-mcp results.

configurationHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical configuration, or request parameters for raw and local policies.

controlsHash.description: SHA-256 of the complete canonical author-controls object recorded for this result.

policy.description: Declared control usage, provider access, manuscript mutation and source-freshness checks.

mode.description: Configured native analysis, raw native analysis, explicit author evidence, provider processing or local processing.

usesSavedProjectControls.description: Whether configured or author-evidence analysis selected saved project controls.

authorIntentionsApplied.description: Whether configured analysis included nonempty saved scene intentions.

suppressionsApplied.description: Whether configured analysis included saved finding-suppression rules.

allowsRawNativeAnalysis.description: Whether this request selected raw native analysis without saved project controls.

providerAccess.description: Whether provider access was enabled for this operation; does not certify successful provider output.

mutatesManuscript.description: Whether this operation edits manuscript text; always false for these envelopes.

revisionChecked.description: Whether applicable saved-input revisions were rechecked before completion.

documentId.description: Saved document UUID whose rewrite was unavailable.

enhanced.description: No complete rewrite was returned by the provider.

availability.description: Explicit provider failure status for an unavailable rewrite.

status.description: No usable complete rewrite is available.

reason.description: The provider failed or returned empty, incomplete or oversized output.
